before: Promise<string> describes a promise whose successful result is text. An async function returns a promise even when its body returns a plain string. await reads the fulfilled value inside an async function.

Complete async makeBadge(label:string):Promise<string>. Return "Badge: " plus label from its body. Callers await the promise to get the string. Use no network request, timer or external data. Empty text remains an empty suffix.
after: A promise represents a result that may become available later. Promise<string> means its successful result is text. An async function always returns a promise, even when its body returns a plain string.
